relations.gap: none, for customer and account; L1.identity also names a trade number, but trade identity is out of this job's scope (see job:trade-lifecycle).

L1.hole.change-effective-time: incremental customer and account change records carry no moment of their own; this model assigns them no effective_from, so as-of coverage does not extend to any customer or account whose only statements come from those files.

current-version coverage depends on effective_from being known for every statement of a thing (see sg.history-asof's gap); where it is not, the current statement for that customer or account cannot yet be determined.

L1.hole.owner-change-reversions-account: whether a change to a customer's own standing alone causes a new statement of that customer's accounts is not decided here; this model requires only that whatever account statements exist carry the current owner link, not that a customer change triggers a new account statement.

chain/anchors/sources-v1.json anchors no constructed-scenario source for customer-level changes, so this model cannot yet label a constructed customer statement; coverage is limited to account-level constructed scenarios.
